posts.author: lucairo123
posts.body: Does anyone have any ideas of if it’s possible and how to make a game with a leveling system like stardew valley or RuneScape in rpgmaker? Basically instead of your character just having one level , they have multiple skills they can level up , and these include non-combat activities like farming , cooking, and building .

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
This is pretty easy to do - all you do use assign variables to track the levels of each skill, and you can use events to create gauges or use any plugin that lets you plug in variables.
There are also dedicated plugins, I Googled "rpg maker mz skill levels":
